extracted.intended_audience: users of the Webcomic Archive (readers, curators, and people recommending comics)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and site policies for using the Webcomic Archive web interface: what the archive is for, how comics are presented and ordered, which comics can be viewed locally, how to recommend/report comics, available user settings, and keyboard shortcuts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of the Webcomic Archive
rubrics_metrics.description: The Webcomic Archive maintains backup copies of hundreds of different online comics and graphic novels to prevent good stories from being lost to time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The archive is intended as an 'archive of last resort' for comics that are unavailable elsewhere; users are encouraged to support creators by visiting their official websites when those are available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local badge viewing policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Only comics with the Local badge can be viewed from the archive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comics without the Local badge are not served from the archive. For comics still available online, the archive will direct readers to the creator's website instead of providing a local copy.

rubrics_metrics.name: External-link behavior for non-local comics
rubrics_metrics.description: Comics without the Local badge are still available online and will direct readers to the creator's website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When the official website for a comic is available, the archive shows an 'Official Website Available' notice and encourages users to support the creator by visiting that site rather than viewing a cached copy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comic page ordering mechanism
rubrics_metrics.description: Comic pages are lexically sorted by filename.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because some webcomics do not use ordered or consistent filenames, automatic renaming is applied but may not always fix order; bonus pages, refactors, or inconsistent naming can cause strips to appear out of order. Users should be aware that apparent ordering issues stem from filenames, not the archive viewer.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to recommend, request, or report comics
rubrics_metrics.description: To recommend comics for inclusion in the archive, request comics be made available for viewing, or report problems accessing the archive, contact admin@webcomicarchive.com.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided administrative contact rather than in-page controls; the page does not list alternate workflows or forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: User settings and filters
rubrics_metrics.description: The archive provides multiple UI settings and comic-list filters: Theme, Dark mode, Show sidebar, Show progressbar, Fit comics to screen, Use custom scrollbars; Comic List filters such as Show NSFW comics, Show favorites only, Show separate headings for recommended/recently updated/unread comics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adjust these settings to customize reading experience (e.g., fit comics to screen vs full-size). The page implies NSFW comics can be hidden and that favorites and status-based headings can be toggled to change list presentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Available actions and maintenance tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Actions available include Mark all comics as read, Import bookmarks, Export bookmarks, Clear file cache, Clear favicon cache.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These actions help manage local archive state. No automated scheduling or confirmation dialogs are described on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keyboard shortcuts for navigation and display
rubrics_metrics.description: Keyboard shortcuts: W = First comic; A or ← = Previous comic; S = Last comic; D or → = Next comic; E = Toggle favorite; F = Highlight the filter box; Space or 0 = Toggle the image display mode between full-size and fit-to-screen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these shortcuts for efficient navigation and quick toggling between full-size and fit-to-screen image display modes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistics and archive metadata display
rubrics_metrics.description: The interface shows statistics such as Archived comics, Completed, NSFW, Recently updated, Marked unread, and Archive size (GB, files, directories).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These statistics are presented to inform users about archive contents and status; on the provided page values are placeholders (zeros) but the feature exists to surface archive metrics.
